desc: 户外木长凳与点线账页体系的青瓜清透爽肤套图
name: 青瓜田园清透平衡爽肤水款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击：户外木长凳上的整瓶直立方图，用晨间暖阳与青瓜确立田园清透基调。
主图一秒法则：瓶身自绿色凝胶浪冠中升起，配三枚玻璃数字珠竖排标签，一次讲清核心主张。
shots.textZone: 左上三枚玻璃数字珠各带一条竖排标签栏，自上而下读 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」

shots.intent: 把常见的六种肌肤困扰摊成六宫格替消费者说出问题，格内只给抽象质地隐喻与空标签槽。
shots.textZone: 顶部墨橄榄留白带一条空标题槽，六格下方各一条空标签槽读 「{callout_1}」至「{callout_6}」

shots.intent: 把产品放进清晨采摘后的一天，用藤篮与麻布完成生活方式代入而不喊任何功效。
用一笔画开的凝露拖尾证明水感质地，以可见材质取代不可见的功效宣称。
用空白点线账页承接规格疑问，行名保留、数值格一律留空以免编造事实。
shots.textZone: 左侧实色绿标块一条标题槽读 「{callout_1}」，右列六行空白参数账，数值格全部留空

shots.intent: 让买家在同一光位下三种口径之间自选，一次看清套组而不写容量数字。
用四张成分图鉴卡解释配方来源，卡内只留图像位与空标签，不点定植物学名与产地。
shots.textZone: 顶部一条空标题槽读 「{callout_1}」，四卡下方各一条空标签槽读 「{callout_2}」至「{callout_5}」

shots.intent: 用留白的验证印章框与包装账条承接资质信息，画面内不出现任何伪造结论或检测字样。
shots.textZone: 右上木面留白带一条空标题槽读 「{callout_1}」，三枚印章框内一律留空

shots.intent: 收口：套组与一个空白按钮位同框，只给行动占位而不写任何优惠数字或会员字样。
shots.textZone: 右上留白带一条空标题槽读 「{selling_point_1}」，右下空按钮位读 「{callout_1}」

style.backgroundSystem: two linked fields only: a weathered timber bench #6E4A2C set against a softly out-of-focus foliage wall #1E2B18 for the outdoor screens, and a dew-paper page #F2F7E9 with stacked pale leaf boards #E7EFDC for the ledger screens; deep ink-olive #2A3A22 is the only dark panel and it never carries a gradient
style.direction: harvest-bench botanical skincare commerce: a sunlit outdoor produce bench paired with a paper ingredient ledger
style.iconSystem: hairline monoline icons drawn in cucumber-rind #5C7A32 at a single weight with square terminals; hollow glass number beads are the only dimensional marker; no filled badges, no medals, no 3D glyphs
style.lightingSystem: warm late-morning daylight at 5200K, one directional key entering from the upper left and skimming across every surface, long soft shadows laid to the right, bounce fill keeping the shadow area open, no hard specular hotspots and no blacked-out studio falloff
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: harvest-bench botanical skincare system held consistent across the entire image set; fixed palette of a dew-paper field #F2F7E9, pale leaf boards #E7EFDC, cucumber-rind green #5C7A32, ink-olive type #2A3A22 and one sun-honey accent #C0862F, with a weathered timber bench #6E4A2C and an out-of-focus foliage wall #1E2B18 reserved for the outdoor screens; warm late-morning daylight at 5200K with one directional key from the upper left skimming across every surface, long soft shadows to the right and open bounce in the shadow area, no hard speculars; one modern geometric sans-serif with vertical stacked label rails and dot-leader ledger rows as the only layout devices; hairline monoline icons in #5C7A32 only; matte leaf-green gel pools #A8C24E instead of clear water splash; the product stays upright, full-height and identically scaled with its label band facing camera; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no clear-water splashes or floating bubbles, no laboratory set dressing, no model faces.
noDrift: no colour palette changes outside #F2F7E9, #E7EFDC, #5C7A32, #2A3A22, #A8C24E, #6E4A2C, #1E2B18 and #C0862F
no mixed fonts, no script or handwritten lettering
no seamless studio sweeps, tiled walls, marble slabs or laboratory benches
no clear-water splashes, ripple rings, floating bubbles, ice cubes or aerosol mist
no medals, certificate scans, lab reports, clinical cross-sections or instrument read-outs
no model faces, hands or identifiable people
no invented numerals of any kind inside the frame
style.presentationRules: the product stays upright, full-height and identically scaled with its label band facing camera; only one unit in the single-product screens and three units in the set screen; props stay below the shoulder line and never overlap the label band; liquid is rendered as a matte leaf-green gel pool #A8C24E rather than clear water
style.surfaceSystem: weathered timber bench #6E4A2C with open grain, a striped raw linen runner, shallow unmarked glass saucers, and matte pale leaf boards #E7EFDC used as low risers
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif in ink-olive #2A3A22; layout devices are limited to vertical stacked label rails running down the side of the product and dot-leader ledger rows on the page; headline 28-40pt, label 10-14pt, never more than one headline per screen
